summary: slurp fetches a remote file's contents as a base64 blob in memory (needs about twice the file size in RAM) and works on Windows.
questions: How do I read a remote file's content into a variable?
Is slurp good for large files?

answer_card.title: Read remote files with slurp
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.slurp` returns a remote file's content as an in-memory base64 blob (use `| b64decode`). Needs at least 2x the file size in RAM, so avoid huge files. Works on Windows.
